verdict.rationale: Jules documents that it runs in its own virtual machine, where it clones the code, installs dependencies and modifies files. A community user confirms it runs in cloud VMs rather than on the local machine, so work happens in an isolated environment rather than against the user's live systems. The docs never frame this VM as a test sandbox or say anything about production data. The Railway preview-environment report is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: explicit documentation of running tests in the sandbox, guarantees about isolation from production data or services, details of the sandbox configuration, independent hands-on corroboration of testing in the VM.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
